name: blerg-workspace
description: npm workspace root: the chat package and the two web apps built from it (the runner's and the board's) share one install. core/web keeps its own.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/chat && npm run pack:manifest -w packages/chat && npm run build -w runner/frontend && npm run build -w board/web
scripts.test: npm test -w packages/chat && npm test -w runner/frontend && npm test -w board/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w packages/chat && npm run lint -w runner/frontend && npm run lint -w board/web
